answer: The cheapest real defence: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because mesa only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, haven is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any ocean approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
